headline: Stanford Discovers Way to Save Ghostly Corals from the Brink
meta_description: Stanford researchers have found a breakthrough method to save bleached corals facing extinction, offering new hope for reef ecosystems worldwide.
summary_short: Stanford researchers have discovered a way to rescue bleached corals from extinction. The breakthrough offers renewed hope for threatened reef ecosystems.
body:
Stanford researchers have discovered a method to save bleached corals facing extinction. The breakthrough provides fresh hope for reef ecosystems threatened by environmental damage.

Bleached corals—pale, ghostly remnants of their former selves—have become an urgent conservation concern as warming oceans and environmental stress damage these vital marine habitats. The Stanford discovery represents a turning point in efforts to restore and protect coral populations from further decline.

This advance demonstrates that science-backed solutions can address even the most fragile ecosystems. As coral bleaching events continue worldwide, discoveries like Stanford's offer a tangible path forward for preserving these irreplaceable marine environments and the countless species that depend on them.
quick_facts: Stanford researchers developed a new coral-saving method
Targets ghostly bleached corals facing extinction
Offers hope for threatened reef ecosystems globally
